Ron Higgs who had travelled to Cardiff with Laurie and Charlie also ran very well and was delighted to finish in third place in front of Maurice Morrell.

He finished an amazing 31st in the actual race, easily first in the M60 event and over 80 seconds ahead of Maurice Morrell who had gone past a tired looking Ron Higgs in the latter stages of the race.
